text:
Alice: Hey team, customer (acct: acme-inc) opened a billing ticket — SDK estimator (js-sdk v0.9.3) shows ~1,240 tokens for a single chat request but the invoice/meter shows ~1,980 tokens. Request id from customer: req_04a1f7ef. Can we confirm what the extra tokens are?
Ben: Do we have the raw payload or a repro curl?
Alice: Customer provided a sanitized repro, pasted below. They say there were no function calls client-side.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-1-large","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following page..."}],"stream":false}'
```
Alice: SDK estimate output: 1240 tokens. Invoice/meter: 1980 tokens. Customer insists they didn't call any tools.
Carla: Two common things: server-injected system messages (preamble expansions) and tool/function outputs generated by the runtime. SDK estimator counts only the client-visible payload.
Ben: Can we fetch the meter breakdown by request id? If we have a debug trace it will show server_injected tokens.
Alice: I ran a debug trace with X-Redwood-Debug: trace and pulled the meter snippet from the trace logs:
```
"meter": {"prompt_tokens": 950, "completion_tokens": 1030, "total": 1980, "server_injected": 480}
```
Ben: That 480 looks like the missing chunk. Any clue what produced it?
Alice: Logs show that the request triggered the "url-unfurler" tool in the runtime (an internal plugin that expands certain links). It returned a ~400-byte payload that was appended to the conversation prior to generation. The SDK estimator never sees that.
Carla: So the delta = server_injected + any assistant-side expansions. Also note some model families expand system prompt into long token sequences depending on config.
Ben: Actionable items: (1) explain to customer that server-side tools and injected prompts are metered and can produce differences; (2) offer to re-run with tools disabled or route to a dedicated instance to avoid runtime plugins; (3) long-term: add a header with meter breakdown to the API response.
Billing-Bot: Case SB-2187 created for acme-inc; billing note added.
Alice: Customer asked for a goodwill credit. Do we have a policy for cases where server-injected tokens weren't obvious to the customer?
Carla: For first-time customers we typically offer a one-off partial credit while we improve docs. Also update the SDK docs: estimator limitations + a flag to estimate "server overhead" in the next SDK release.
Ben: I'll follow up with infra to see whether we can surface X-Redwood-Meter (or similar) in responses to reduce confusion.
Alice: I'll reply to acme-inc with the repro + meter snippet, offer to re-run with tools off, and mention the SDK upgrade path when v0.10 ships. Thanks all :thumbsup:
